text:
alex: Quick check — onboarding zeta-13b. Model metadata points to HF /open/zeta-13b v1 but I can't find the weights in our registry mirror. Who owns the S3 path? I'm blocked on staging deploy.

pri: Did we get a presign from sourcing? I remember a dry run yesterday. The expected path was s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v1/weights.pt

ken: @alex that path sounds like staging-only. Production mirror is s3://redwood-prod/models/zeta-13b/v1/. Try the presign script: `./scripts/presign.sh s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v1/weights.pt`

lina: quick tokenizer note — zeta's tokenizer uses a nonstandard bos_id (not 1). We've seen pad offset off-by-one on streaming clients. Recommend adding `tokenizer.padding_side = 'left'` in the model config to avoid weird decoding during canaries.

alex: thanks. pri, can you confirm ACLs? I tried the presign URL and got AccessDenied.

pri: looking now. onboarding-bot role didn't have s3:GetObject on the artifacts bucket. Pushed a policy change to allow sts:AssumeRole + s3:GetObject for onboarding-bot — give it ~30s to propagate.

ingest-bot: deploy-checker: Mirror manifest validation failed — missing checksum for shard-0003, integrity gate triggered.

ken: simplest fix is to compute `sha256sum weights.pt` on the origin and add the digest to the manifest under shards/shard-0003.checksum. Our mirrorer will reject missing checksums.

alex: copying sha256 from origin: `a3f5b2c9d1e4... (truncated)` — who can reupload shard-0003?

lina: @ken I'll kick off the mirror job now to re-push shard-0003. FYI tokenizer vocab.json had trailing comment lines which our loader rejects; I'll strip comments in the mirror step.

pri: ACLs look fixed from my side, presign now returns 200 and a URL: https://presign.internal/abcd1234 — :thumbsup:

alex: perfect. once shard checksum is in manifest and presign works, can someone mark the artifact as READY in the registry so I can start the canary?

ken: manifest updated with checksum, pushed. Ran local integrity check, tests green. Also pro-tip: set `serve.config.max_batch_tokens=16000` for this model on staging (it was timing out at default 8k for long-context workloads).

alex: applied the batch tokens change and flipped the canary. I'll monitor latency and token-cost. Thanks all, will post results.

ingest-bot: deploy-checker: Canary started at 2850001300 for zeta-13b v1. Observability hooks attached.
